overview: FStreamX is a Netflix-style OTT streaming platform with a dark cinematic UI featuring horizontal scrolling content rows, auto-rotating hero banner, hover-expand cards, and a full seasons/episodes/parts system for TV shows, anime, and dramas.
features: Netflix-style horizontal scrolling category rows with arrow navigation
Auto-rotating hero banner with manual carousel dots
Hover-expand cards with title, genre, rating, and action overlays
Seasons/episodes/parts system for TV shows, anime, and dramas
Admin panel to manage seasons, episodes, and parts
Content detail page with season dropdown, episode list, and part selector
Instagram ID displayed in footer with logo
